intent: Fix hierarchy, measure, and rhythm in the text itself.
moves: Cap the measure near 68 characters; long lines lose the reader between rows.
Set body leading around 1.5, and tighten it as text gets larger, never the reverse.
Use size and weight together for hierarchy — one of them alone reads as an accident.
Give headings more space above than below, so they bind to the text they introduce.
Use tabular figures anywhere numbers stack in a column.
avoid: More than three distinct sizes on one surface.
Letter-spacing on body text, which is set for its size already.
Centred paragraphs of more than two lines.
